name: Genibo
def: Korean entertainment robot dog styled as a bull terrier, sold as a home pet with voice command control.
body: Genibo walked on four servo driven legs and carried a camera, touch sensors and microphones in a glossy plastic body shaped after a bull terrier. Onboard software gave it a personality that changed with handling, and it recognised a set of spoken commands and could be taught simple tricks. Dasarobot showed a prototype in 2006 and sold the robot from 2008 at around fifteen hundred US dollars, with later versions adding English language software.
facts: One of very few consumer walking robot pets to reach market after Sony ended AIBO
Sold internationally from 2008 at about 1,500 US dollars
specs: Colour camera, touch sensors on head, back and flanks, microphones, tilt sensor
Onboard personality and voice command software
